about: Enrol in home-schooling, the general academic stream or the literacy programme.
note: Requirements read from the official MOE service page on the checked date. MOE fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Continuing education registration. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Home-schooling track is open to citizens and residents of all nationalities, Grades 7 to 12
General academic stream is for female citizens, wives of citizens and daughters of female citizens
Literacy track is for people aged nine and over
A level test applies to some applicants
documents: Equivalency certificate for the latest certificate (new enrolment only)
Proof of residence for residents and GCC students in the home study and level test tracks
fees: Free for the literacy and general academic tracks
channels: MOE website or mobile app, sign in with UAE PASS
